adversarial: A hosted-label or schedule regression is refused by the pin's first three tests: every runs-on is exactly the self-hosted concordia-build label with no hosted label anywhere, and no schedule/cron trigger exists.

Version drift is refused twice — by the pin (UNITY_VERSION pin == ProjectVersion.txt m_EditorVersion 6000.5.9f1, cross-read from the project file, not a literal) and by the workflow's own resolve step at runtime.

Absent downstream tools can never pass silently: a missing pull-assets fails the run by name (tests without the rail's assets would test a different project); a missing budget.mjs is visibly skipped by name (hashFiles-gated).
An unconfigured R2 upload fails by name after the builds — it never uploads nowhere quietly.
